table.name: Cruise Control Switch
table.description: Exact 1EK7A only. Selects the cruise control steering switch that the ECM decodes. Not Installed: the ECM ignores the steering switch buttons, so the runtime steering-switch gestures, such as the Map Switching selection, have no input. ICC Switch (5 Buttons): the ECM decodes the five-button ICC steering switch with DISTANCE, as stock JK08A does. The switch changes only this byte: cruise control itself also needs an ICC unit and the ICC CAN mailboxes of JK08A, which this byte does not configure. Hardware evidence covers stock JK08A only.
